description: Set or change your developer fee. Fields you omit keep their value; null stops charging that part, but at least one part must remain (use remove_developer_fee to stop it altogether). Applies to transactions quoted after the change.

fixedAmountUsd.description: Fixed USD amount per routing onramp and offramp, as a decimal string with at most 2 decimals, above 0 and at most 10. Omit to keep the current value; null to stop charging it.

percent.description: Percent of every routing onramp and offramp, as a decimal string with at most 2 decimals, above 0 and at most 10. Omit to keep the current value; null to stop charging it.

name: set_developer_fee
title: Set developer fee
